title: Bootstrap VM – memory and load
esql:
FROM metrics-prometheus.collector-*
| WHERE prometheus.labels.instance == "10.0.1.4:9100" AND prometheus.node_memory_MemTotal_bytes.value IS NOT NULL
| EVAL mem_used_pct = 100.0 * (1 - prometheus.node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes.value / prometheus.node_memory_MemTotal_bytes.value)
| STATS mem_used_pct = ROUND(MAX(mem_used_pct), 1),
        mem_avail_mb = ROUND(MIN(prometheus.node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes.value) / 1048576.0),
        load1 = MAX(prometheus.node_load1.value)
  BY minute = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 minute)
| SORT minute DESC

title: Bootstrap VM – CPU busy %
esql:
FROM metrics-prometheus.collector-*
| WHERE prometheus.labels.instance == "10.0.1.4:9100" AND prometheus.node_cpu_seconds_total.rate IS NOT NULL
| STATS idle = SUM(CASE(prometheus.labels.mode == "idle", prometheus.node_cpu_seconds_total.rate, 0.0)),
        total = SUM(prometheus.node_cpu_seconds_total.rate)
  BY minute = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 minute)
| EVAL cpu_busy_pct = ROUND(100.0 * (1 - idle / total), 1)
| KEEP minute, cpu_busy_pct
| SORT minute DESC

title: Bootstrap VM – disk space
esql:
FROM metrics-prometheus.collector-*
| WHERE prometheus.labels.instance == "10.0.1.4:9100" AND prometheus.node_filesystem_size_bytes.value IS NOT NULL
    AND prometheus.labels.fstype IN ("ext4", "xfs", "vfat")
| STATS size_gb = ROUND(MAX(prometheus.node_filesystem_size_bytes.value) / 1073741824.0, 1),
        avail_gb = ROUND(MIN(prometheus.node_filesystem_avail_bytes.value) / 1073741824.0, 1),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY prometheus.labels.mountpoint
| EVAL used_pct = ROUND(100.0 * (1 - avail_gb / size_gb), 1)
| SORT used_pct DESC

title: Bootstrap VM – network throughput
esql:
FROM metrics-prometheus.collector-*
| WHERE prometheus.labels.instance == "10.0.1.4:9100" AND prometheus.node_network_receive_bytes_total.rate IS NOT NULL
    AND prometheus.labels.device != "lo"
    AND NOT prometheus.labels.device LIKE "veth*" AND NOT prometheus.labels.device LIKE "br-*" AND prometheus.labels.device != "docker0"
| STATS rx_kb = SUM(prometheus.node_network_receive_bytes_total.rate) / 1024.0,
        tx_kb = SUM(prometheus.node_network_transmit_bytes_total.rate) / 1024.0
  BY minute = BUCKET(@timestamp, 1 minute), prometheus.labels.device
| EVAL rx_kb = ROUND(rx_kb), tx_kb = ROUND(tx_kb)
| SORT minute DESC
